heading: Principal
body: This power of attorney is granted by {principal_name} of {principal_address}, {principal_id} (the Principal).

heading: Appointment of agent
body: The Principal appoints {agent_name} of {agent_address} as the Principal's agent (the Agent) under this instrument.

heading: Nature of this power of attorney
body: {durability_language}

heading: Limits on this power
body: This power of attorney is limited to the following matters and confers no authority beyond them: {limitation}

heading: Commencement
body: The authority conferred by this instrument commences {effective_date}. It continues until the Principal revokes it in writing, or until it otherwise ends by operation of law.

heading: Powers granted - financial matters
body: The Principal grants the Agent authority over the financial matters listed below and over no other financial matter.
{powers:financial}

heading: Powers granted - healthcare matters
body: The Principal grants the Agent authority over the healthcare matters listed below and over no other healthcare matter, and the Agent must act in accordance with the Principal's known wishes.
{powers:healthcare}

heading: Access to health information
body: The Agent may see and receive the Principal's health information only so far as it is needed to exercise the powers granted under clause {clause_ref:powers-healthcare}, and for no other purpose.

heading: Powers granted - real property
body: The Principal grants the Agent authority over the real property described below and over no other property.
{powers:real_property}
The real property to which clause {clause_ref:powers-real-property} applies is: {real_property_description}

heading: Successor agent
body: If the Agent dies, resigns, becomes unable to act or is unwilling to act, {successor_name} of {successor_address} shall act as successor agent with the same authority, and subject to the same limits, as this instrument confers on the Agent.

heading: Reliance by third parties
body: A third party who is shown this instrument may rely on it until that third party has actual notice that it has been revoked. A successor agent appointed under clause {clause_ref:successor} is subject to the same condition.

heading: Governing law and execution requirements
body: This instrument is drawn for {jurisdiction_label}. {governing_law} {witness_requirement} {notarisation_requirement}
{notice:external-execution}
